Rule 20 of Scheme of Selection Rules
As per Rule 20, of the Scheme of Selection Rules, the Merit cum Roster list has to be prepared after taking in to consideration, all the Rosters available and notified (including sports quota). Therefore, is it fair to presume that the call letter issued after this step is only subject to the certificate verification and no other subjectivity.

Extract from GO amending Sports Policy
The GO passed by the TDP alliance Government on 10th December, 2024, enabling the direct recruitment without examination was subsequently modified and the requirement of securing qualifying marks in the exams was reintroduced. 
Reason cited for modification – Difficulties have arisen & several representations and grievances were received from various sportspersons
